50030102.text: He was a formidable opponent — exactly what I would expect from the First of the Fatui Harbingers.

50030103.text: I never imagined someone could match you in combat...

50030104.text: If the Tsaritsa sent him here, why would he bring up what happened "five centuries ago"?

50030105.text: Yeah, and how much does he know about Natlan...?

50030106.text: The Harbingers are all driven by their own personal goals. The only purpose that unites them is collecting the Gnoses.

50030107.text: But I'm sure The Captain has his own reasons for being here as well.

50030108.text: Whatever his motive, we should shift our focus to the Fatui. If they attack again and we're not prepared, we're done for.

50030109.text: No. We're running out of time.

50030110.text: The wound I inflicted should hold him back and weaken him for the time being.

50030111.text: Besides, I'm sure you noticed... The power that came to his rescue just now came from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

50030112.text: In other words, there are traitors among us.

50030113.text: Not necessarily. This could prove to be a very valuable turn of events.

50030114.text: When we exchanged final blows, I sensed an unusual presence within him. I'll need to investigate further.

50030115.text: Kinich, go to the Masters of the Night-Wind and look into who could have aided the Captain. Speak to Citlali — she should know.

50030116.text: Of course. I'll head out right now. Do you still intend to...

50030118.text: Natlan's strength has never rested solely in its Archon.

50030119.text: Together, we foresaw the only path that leads to our nation's future. We must trust in that vision now.

50030121.text: Completely fine. Just lamenting the fact that I never got a picture when I could still turn my hair into flames. Hehe, too late, now.

50030122.text: ...I just hope the others have a safe journey.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a walk around the People of the Springs

50030201.text: Paimon feels like a whole new Paimon after those two days in the hot springs. The Abyss kinda threw a wrench in our relaxation, though.

50030202.text: Still, spending time here really has felt like a vacation!

50030203.text: The Koholasaurs are so nice, and so fun to play with. Their bellies are super bouncy!

50030204.text: Oh, and Atea's snacks were so delicious! She gave Paimon some for the road just this morning, actually.

50030206.text: Yelling at some kids who got caught throwing stones in the hot springs... So, not much has changed since we first met her.

50030207.text: Hey, you guys! Sleep well last night?

50030208.text: Yep! This area is so nice, hehe.

50030209.text: Glad you like it! I was thinking of taking you guys out to do some sea-fishing. Later tonight, we can eat whatever we catch. Fresh fish is absolutely delicious right off the grill!

50030212.text: The team sent out to fight in the Night Warden Wars has returned.

50030213.text: And Kachina? Is she back as well?

50030215.text: But, don't worry! The team was victorious, so the Rite of Resurrection will be held at the Stadium soon.

50030216.text: That's a relief. The Abyss is cunning, and it was her first time. Mistakes are bound to happen.

50030217.text: Exactly. She deserves to hold her head up high.

50030218.text: Alright, thanks for letting me know. We'll head out in a bit.

50030219.text: Geez, she sounded a little anxious there — had me thinking it was bad news for a moment.

50030220.text: Mualani, you said the Abyss was "cunning" just now. But, it seems like the Abyss just wants to destroy everything!

50030221.text: Like, think about all those monsters that attacked your tribe. If there really was some sort of "cunning" plan, wouldn't it make more sense to send them to attack Kachina and her small team?

50030222.text: Ummm, not that Paimon wants them to be in any more danger! It's just...

50030223.text: Haha, relax, I get it. The Abyss is difficult to understand, that's for sure.

50030224.text: At a glance, it certainly seems like the only goal is total destruction. The Abyss isn't a living entity, after all, so what capacity for logic or planning could it possibly possess?

50030225.text: But, through our long history of fighting the Abyss, we've realized things aren't quite so simple.

50030226.text: Five hundred years ago, the Abyss invaded Teyvat. You know about that, right?

50030228.text: That's right. Khaenri'ah suffered greatly during that time, but so did every other nation in Teyvat.

50030229.text: And Natlan was the worst affected of all. It took the combined efforts of the then-Pyro Archon and heroes from every tribe to finally repel the Abyss.

50030230.text: Even so, the effects of the invasion lingered for hundreds of years, only able to be reversed little by little.

50030231.text: Our tribe's waters were contaminated. The Children of Echoes' territory was overrun by dangerous sludge surging from underground. Unrelenting black winds tore across the lands of the Flower-Feather Clan...

50030232.text: It was like each disaster was "designed" for a specific tribe.

50030233.text: So the Abyss understood the foundation of each tribe?

50030234.text: Exactly. We once thought that the Abyss' desire for destruction was a sort of primal instinct, but its methods are, in truth, marked by intelligence.

50030235.text: We now believe the Abyss has invaded the Night Kingdom, and has the capacity to read the memories of this land at any given moment.

50030236.text: And that's how it became so dangerous and cunning, almost like it knows you inside and out...

50030237.text: Yes, and that's why we've been unable to fully eradicate it, even after all this time.

50030238.text: Luckily, the problems left behind by the Abyss have been successfully addressed by the various Pyro Archons we've had over the years.

50030239.text: Now, every tribe is prospering, and things are looking up. I mean, just look at what we managed to do a few days ago! We totally fought them off!

50030240.text: (In other nations, I've seen how much effort it takes to truly eradicate the Abyss.)

50030241.text: (The people of Natlan live in its shadow every day. Who knows how long it will take for this war to end...)

50030242.text: You must have had to sacrifice a lot to get to this point...

50030243.text: Every battle, every sacrifice is in pursuit of a future where we get to stop fighting.

50030244.text: Responsibility, duty, unavoidable burden... Everyone in Natlan views the war differently.

50030245.text: But, I believe we WILL be rid of the Abyss one day, and the efforts of all who fought against them will become a story for the ages!

50030246.text: To think that my name could survive in ballads passed down to future generations... It's kind of romantic.

50030247.text: Everyone has something that drives them forward, you know?

50030249.text: We have to — not only for ourselves, but for our future.

50030252.text: Anyway, let's head to the Stadium. Our fishing trip can wait until Kachina's back with us.

50030251.text: Haha, be my guest! Heroes are always welcome in Natlan.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame
Go to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

50030401.text: Whoa, this place is packed already.

50030402.text: Of course! No one's gonna miss out on the chance to welcome our heroes back from battle, hehe. It's their moment of glory!

50030403.text: Kachina's gonna be so flustered. She's never had this many eyes on her before.

50030404.text: Yeah, she doesn't seem like the kind of person who likes being the center of attention.

50030405.text: Looks like I'm just in time.

50030407.text: Yeah, a commission ran longer than expected, but I made it. I heard about the incident with your tribe, Mualani. Is everyone alright?

50030408.text: #Yeah, it's all taken care of. Our new friend here's got some tricks up {M#his}{F#her} sleeve, by the way. {M#He}{F#She}'s just as strong as Kachina made {M#him}{F#her} out to be.

50030411.text: Hey, look! Is it about to start?

50030412.text: That's right. Someone will come out and recite a eulogy, and then we'll sing the Ode of Resurrection together.

50030413.text: C'mon, let's find a spot with a good view. When the singing starts, just follow my lead, and you'll be fine.

50030414.text: Let's go somewhere higher up, so Kachina can spot us.

50030415.text: Warriors of Natlan — heed the call of life.

50030416.text: We are the inheritors of memory and legend.

50030417.text: Those who grew alongside sun and wind.

50030418.text: Those who forged our own destiny and future.

50030419.text: That is Natlan's fire, the lifeblood of our nation.

50030421.text: I could not find Kachina within the Night Kingdom, or locate her Ancient Name.

50030423.text: Uh. What does that even mean?

50030424.text: Usually, once the Ode is complete, the Pyro Archon and resurrected person will emerge from the flames, but something went wrong...

50030427.text: Well, I think it's pretty obvious. Clearly, the team sent to fight the Abyss didn't win after all.

50030428.text: Think about it! The Ode rekindles all victors — we've witnessed it countless times.

50030429.text: Since the Archon couldn't find Kachina in the Night Kingdom, that must mean there's more to this "victory" than meets the eye.

50030430.text: Hey! You just haven't gotten over the fact that Kachina beat you in the Pilgrimage!

50030432.text: Your wild guesses are misplaced. We completed our mission.

50030433.text: Maybe YOU did, but who's to say whether that little girl even contributed at all? Maybe she got scared and ran off...

50030434.text: Why would the Wayob recognize someone like her, even if she was on the winning team.

50030435.text: How dare you insult a hero of Natlan like that!

50030436.text: Kachina sacrificed herself to repel the Abyss. She doesn't deserve to be subjected to your vile rumors when she's not even here to defend herself!

50030437.text: Calm down, Mualani, there's no point in arguing with the likes of them.

50030438.text: I can't just sit here and let them slander her like that!

50030439.text: To "insult a hero of Natlan," the person actually has to be a hero.

50030441.text: Think about it, everyone! Who do you think is really at fault here? A girl who never should've even gone to war...

50030442.text: Or the great Pyro Archon? Why would the rules of our nation suddenly stop working!?

50030444.text: That's true. If she wasn't revived, it must mean she failed to achieve victory.

50030445.text: Maybe the Wayob interpret "victory" in different ways?

50030446.text: I mean, that girl didn't look all that strong to me...

50030447.text: (The Pyro Archon seems to be deep in thought. Why isn't she putting a stop to the commotion?)

50030448.text: Kachina wouldn't have run. That's not like her at all!

50030449.text: No. She's been waiting for this moment for too long!

50030450.text: No matter how daunting the situation, no matter how scared she might feel, she's always the first person to stand up and face it head-on!

50030451.text: We don't even know what happened, so don't you dare try to use this as an excuse to vent your anger or slander her reputation.

50030452.text: Fine. We'll find out what happened soon enough. Then, we'll see who truly deserves glory...

50030454.text: There is no doubt about today's victory, or Kachina's part in it. She is a hero worthy of our admiration and celebration.

50030455.text: However, the failure of today's ceremony is undeniable. Kachina has not been rekindled, and I offer you all my deepest apologies as I continue to investigate this matter.

50030456.text: To prevent further casualties, I have decided to suspend the Pilgrimage until this matter is resolved.

50030458.text: No one is all-knowing. No one is infallible — not even myself.

50030459.text: But, doubt is a means by which we seek the truth, not a weapon we wield against others.

50030460.text: I—I—I... I didn't mean it that way, Archon, I just...

50030461.text: If there are things you wish to clarify, then ask me directly. Doubt my answer if you wish, but now's your chance. You have concerns? State them.

50030463.text: Even though I have said nothing to change your mind? Then, it would seem the truth never mattered to you at all.

50030464.text: That guy doesn't even have the courage to answer the Pyro Archon's question. So much for all that glory talk earlier.

50030466.text: My friend, Kachina... Do you have any idea where she is? It's extremely important to me!

50030467.text: I know you said you were investigating the situation, but... I'm sorry, that's not enough!

50030468.text: I've already shared everything I know. If you want to learn the truth and rescue your friend sooner, you should join the investigation.

50030471.text: In that case, come see me in the Speaker's Chamber.

50030473.text: #Oh, and, if it's not too much trouble, could you drop by as well, {NICKNAME}? I'd like to have a chat.

50030474.text: Rest assured, everyone, I'll keep the tribal chiefs informed on the progress of the investigation.

50030475.text: Once again, I apologize for the outcome of this ceremony. If there are no further questions, let's part for now.

50030476.text: Um, did she just... ask us to come along?

50030477.text: I believe she did. Let's go. I'd like to know what's going on myself.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Speaker's Chamber to speak to Mavuika

50030801.text: If we can find Kachina's Ancient Name, I can use the link between them to pinpoint her position within the Night Kingdom.

50030802.text: Then comes the hard part — You need to visit the Night Kingdom in person and rescue her.

50030803.text: But, isn't the Night Kingdom a land of souls? Can we even go there?

50030804.text: Under normal circumstances, only the consciousness can enter, but there is a way to go there in person.

50030805.text: However, know that the Night Kingdom will attempt to repel you, and the Abyss certainly won't leave you be...

50030807.text: Same here. Fighting the Abyss is nothing new for me.

50030809.text: #So, uh, Paimon's the only one who's scared? W—Well, if you're going, {NICKNAME}, Paimon's going too.

50030810.text: Citlali of the Masters of the Night-Wind once created an artifact that can be used to communicate with the Wayob. We call it the Spiritspeaker Stone.

50030811.text: It was originally used as a ceremonial artifact wielded by the tribal chiefs, but that spiritual quality also means it can be used to search for an Ancient Name.

50030812.text: That was the artifact I delivered to the Scions of the Canopy a few days ago. Didn't think I'd be hearing about it again so soon.

50030813.text: Thank you so much for your help, everyone.

50030814.text: Your thanks are unnecessary. I will offer you whatever aid I can, but your fellowship and courage are what will truly decide the success of this operation.

50030815.text: Besides, you're the ones helping me. I can only focus on one thing at a time, after all.

50030816.text: #{NICKNAME}, I certainly didn't expect our first conversation to be so serious.

50030817.text: I've heard all about your accomplishments. Ever since you arrived, I've been hoping to meet you and offer you Natlan's highest level of hospitality.

50030819.text: "Why"? Is that not what happened in the other nations you've visited?

50030822.text: Yeah, things were pretty complicated at the start... and, y'know, in the middle... But, our reputation's solid nowadays!

50030823.text: Haha, that's more like it. After all, I've heard you're someone who transcends fate.

50030824.text: You know quite a lot about me.

50030825.text: Perhaps even more than you can imagine. But we can talk about that some other time.

50030826.text: Ideally, this would be the perfect night for a drink and some musical ambiance. But, there are important things to be done.

50030827.text: Oh, I almost forgot... Atea was wounded in the fight against the Abyss. She wanted us to give this to you.

50030828.text: It "embodies fond memories and my strength of will" — that's what she asked us to tell you. She said you'd know what that means...

50030830.text: I didn't think this day would come so soon. The flames of her life force... I can feel them flowing within the talisman.

50030831.text: If things were different, the two of us could have enjoyed the hot springs together while she gave this to me in person. We're supposed to be "hot spring buddies," after all.

50030832.text: But, don't worry. This talisman means a great deal to me. I'll take good care of it, and once this is all over, I'll pay Atea a visit.

50030833.text: You said you didn't want to jeopardize the production of Contending Fire... But, that's not at all why you decided to suspend the Pilgrimage, is it...

50030834.text: You're right. Even now, the production of Contending Fire is far from sufficient.

50030835.text: The gradual corrosion caused by the Abyss has resulted in a massive shortage of Pyro energy, and we're currently at the breaking point.

50030836.text: As things stand, the Pilgrimage is a lost cause. Suspending it allows us to save our strength to defend the tribes.

50030837.text: The Abyss has brought catastrophe to Natlan, and Kachina's disappearance in the Night Kingdom is a direct consequence of that.

50030838.text: *sigh* We can't let the general public know that.

50030839.text: No. If the public learned that Natlan's destruction was close at hand, there would be immense panic.

50030840.text: But, if I said nothing at all, they would have continued to question the integrity of Natlan's heroes.

50030841.text: Another simple choice. The latter was clearly the better solution, but you chose otherwise.

50030842.text: I have never subscribed to the belief that the "right" choice is the one with the fewest "sacrifices."

50030843.text: Let's go. There's still a way for the Sacred Flame to last a little longer.

50030601.text: The Sacred Flame must never go out. Not only does it strike fear in the Abyss, but it's also the pillar of Natlan's stability.

50030602.text: So, until our heroes are ready, I will sacrifice my power to keep it burning.

50030603.text: But, that can only last so long. I think we should focus on the remaining Ancient Name bearers.

50030604.text: Don't let desperation cloud your judgment...

50030605.text: Those chosen by the Wayob have already embarked on their destined path. It is for them to decide how that journey ends, not us.

50030606.text: All we can do is support them.

50030607.text: Even so, for you to make this sacrifice... It's not right...

50030608.text: Hah, if not me, then who? No other is capable of sustaining the Sacred Flame.

50030609.text: I possess great strength, but I'm not above my people. This is part of my duty.

50030701.text: What's happening at the Stadium!? Did something explode!?

50030702.text: It feels like the Archon unleashed her power. She must be fighting a formidable opponent...

50030703.text: Should we go back and check what's going on?

50030704.text: Kachina doesn't have that much time.

50030705.text: Have faith in the Archon. She wouldn't lose in a one-on-one confrontation.

50030706.text: Once we find Kachina's Ancient Name, we'll head right back.

50030707.text: Okay... Let's just keep climbing. Paimon really hopes nothing goes wrong...

50030501.text: The situation is urgent, so I'll get straight to the point. Kachina is undoubtedly a hero of Natlan, and I'm deeply sorry this happened to her.

50030502.text: There's been unrest in the Night Kingdom, but I don't know what's causing it. As a result, I've been unable to track down her location.

50030503.text: Until we find and address the cause of the unrest, the Ode of Resurrection will continue to be ineffective.

50030504.text: And that means... Kachina won't be able to come back?

50030505.text: That's correct. Not until the problem with the Night Kingdom is resolved.

50030508.text: ...Kachina always dreamed of fighting the Abyss, of doing her part to defend Natlan.

50030509.text: She wasn't afraid of death because she knew, if it came down to it, the Pyro Archon would be there to bring her back to life...

50030510.text: Whenever we sat down together, exhausted from training, she would always hum the Ode of Resurrection...

50030511.text: She was supposed to come back to us. We were supposed to hug her and celebrate with her and share her joy...

50030512.text: We supported her every step of the way, but what are we supposed to do now?

50030513.text: Sit peacefully and wait for her to return? Lose ourselves in grief over her death? Tell me — are we her friends? Or her murderers?

50030515.text: It's alright. I understand your rage and your grief. Kachina's life means a great deal to me, Mualani.

50030516.text: Believe me, I want to bring her back as soon as possible. I would give you that peace of mind if I could.

50030558.text: But please hear what I have to say, so I can at least give you a broader picture of the issue we are now facing.

50030517.text: Considering the recent attack on your tribe, I believe the Abyss has found a new means of undermining the rules of our nation.

50030519.text: The Sacred Flame — the foundation of our resistance against the Abyss.

50030520.text: If we continue to hold the Pilgrimage and send teams to fight the Abyss, there will likely be more casualties.

50030521.text: But, if we stop altogether, the Sacred Flame will only grow weaker. The Abyss will scale up their attacks, and the tragedy we saw with the People of the Springs will only be the first of many.

50030522.text: If we compare the two choices, the former seems to be the lesser of two evils.

50030523.text: ...Sorry. I know that may sound harsh, but I bear the Name "Mal{RUBY#[D]Turnfire}ipo." Weighing the costs is my duty.

50030524.text: The raw truth can be cruel. But we need to understand it if we want to approach this rationally.

50030525.text: But, what would you say, Mualani? This is personal for you, and unlike Kinich, I daresay it's not a simple case of weighing up which course of action is less painful, is it?

50030526.text: No. I can't choose between them, and I don't want to. Saying that one is preferable over the other is disrespectful to the people who suffered...

50030527.text: You're saying it doesn't matter whether I suspend the Pilgrimage... the consequences will be equally painful.

50030528.text: Yes... What happened to Kachina breaks my heart, but I couldn't bring myself to sacrifice other people for her sake...

50030529.text: And that is the crux of the problem. It's not simply a matter of choosing the lesser of two evils.

50030530.text: Either way, there will be people who suffer, and the end result will be the same — belief in the Pilgrimage will waver.

50030531.text: Once doubt has crept in, the people will no longer unite in battle against the Abyss. And that is exactly what the Abyss wants.

50030559.text: Their ultimate goal isn't to break the rules that make the Ode of Resurrection work. It's to destroy the people's faith in them.

50030532.text: To prevent what happened to Kachina from happening to anyone else, we need to suspend the Pilgrimage, so that is my current plan, and in the meantime, I've made efforts to strengthen each tribe's defenses.

50030533.text: Then, we have to find another way of strengthening the Sacred Flame to keep the Abyss at bay. This won't be easy. I'll need time to figure out the best approach.

50030534.text: I understand your anger, Mualani, but I hope that provided some clarity, at least.

50030535.text: Wow, Paimon thought things were gonna get heated for a second, but the Pyro Archon took the time to explain everything so patiently...

50030536.text: I owe you an apology, Archon. I let myself get carried away earlier, and I'm sorry. You're right — we need to focus on finding solutions.

50030537.text: We could always hold the Pilgrimage without sending a team to fight in the Night Warden Wars. That way, we would still be able to fuel the Sacred Flame.

50030538.text: I've considered that, but the two events have nearly always been linked.

50030539.text: Without the chance to fight the Abyss, Pilgrimage rankings lose their prestige, and competitor numbers will drop.

50030540.text: With fewer participants, the amount of Contending Fire produced will decrease, and the vicious cycle will continue indefinitely.

50030541.text: So essentially, the Abyss has taken Kachina hostage...

50030542.text: What happens if you stay in the Night Kingdom for a long period of time?

50030543.text: You've learned about the concept of Ley Lines during your travels, yes? The Night Kingdom is something similar.

50030544.text: Staying there for a short period of time shouldn't have an effect on the person, but with the Abyss in the picture, it's a different story.

50030545.text: Your sense of self will be devoured until, eventually, you become one with the sea of souls.

50030546.text: Imagine pouring a cup of water into a rushing river. You can try to scoop up another cup, but there's no chance it will be the same water you had before.

50030547.text: I won't sugarcoat it — that is the danger Kachina is currently facing.

50030548.text: Just like you said, Archon, both of these problems need to be addressed...

50030549.text: You can focus all your efforts on dealing with the Sacred Flame. I will go search for Kachina.

50030550.text: The Abyss poses the same threat to you as it does to her. It is very possible you will not return. Knowing that, do you still choose to go?

50030551.text: Kachina's waiting for us to rescue her — that's all that matters.

50030552.text: I failed to protect her during our campaign, but I can make it up to her now. I choose to go as well.

50030556.text: Understood. Then, I'll support you in any way I can.

50030557.text: The Masters of the Night-Wind have a technique that can extract an Ancient Name from the Ley Lines.

410010101.text: Friend! That we should meet means that fate has surely smiled upon you. Oh, I have an excellent business proposition for you. If I could just have a moment of your time?

410010102.text: Why do you merchant types always sound so suspicious?

410010103.text: Oh, come now, don't be like that. The integrity of a Liyue merchant is as steadfast as the Geo Archon themselves.

410010104.text: No harm in hearing you out, I guess.

410010105.text: It's simple. Every day you find me some basic items, and trade them in here for a box full of exciting little curios.

410010106.text: Even the worst boxes have precious metals inside them... in the form of Mora cast at the Golden House, no less.

410010107.text: Okay, but what's in it for you?

410010108.text: Oh, my business model is a little too complex to explain right now. But, if I have your consistent support in this business deal, then perhaps I will consider letting you in on how it works one day. Hahaha!

410010110.text: Can't hurt to try it out.

410010201.text: Ahh, I see you've willingly returned. That must mean you trust me, even if only a little.

410010202.text: Paimon's heard of scams that start like this though. They rope you in with all the benefits in the beginning, so you let your guard down and that's when they get ya!

410010203.text: Hahahaha, please! I don't rely on scams to make my Mora. I rely on my keen sense of business trends.

410010301.text: I was once a merchant of curios. Why curios you ask? Well, because logically speaking, the rarer something is, the more expensive it is.

410010302.text: Well Paimon's super rare — there's only one in all of Teyvat! So, ah, where's the Mora?

410010303.text: Ehehehe, something big is about to happen to our world. And what do you think is going to become scarce once that happens?

410010401.text: What was it I was telling you about yesterday? Ahh yes, supply and demand.

410010402.text: You should know, because of Mondstadt's Stormterror attacks, orchard production was affected and stocks are low. As such, we can expect the price of Mondstadt's wines and ciders to go sky-high, all across Teyvat.

410010403.text: Yeah, we know a thing or two about the Stormterror issue...

410010404.text: So, let's see how well you can put two and two together. Tell me, why am I swapping out my curios for basic household items?

410010405.text: Because... the whole world is about to be destroyed!

410010502.text: Ah yes. Okay, so let's say the world really was on the brink of destruction — how would you even know that anyway?

410010503.text: That is one of a merchant's other talents. Not only must we read the market and act accordingly, so too must we have our connections.

410010504.text: I happen to be in the know about some very top secret intel. Intel which has come from none other than the economic authority that is the Qixing themselves.

410010601.text: So yesterday I was telling you about... ah, that's right. The Qixing's intel.

410010602.text: The Qixing are the seven greatest merchants in Liyue, who govern over everything to do with our economy, so it goes without saying that their intel is very accurate.

410010603.text: So just what is this intel then?

410010604.text: Stormterror has affected Mondstadt's agricultural production, whilst the Fatui have been getting rather imperious in Liyue and Inazuma.

410010605.text: According to confidential intel said to have come from Ningguang, Tianquan of the Qixing herself, the Qixing plan to break ties with the Fatui, and simply let Liyue bear the brunt of the economic impact.

410010606.text: And when that time comes, the Qixing will be sure to make a pretty penny off the inflated price of everyday items.

410010607.text: But where would that leave the poor people of Liyue?

410010701.text: No, no, no, this isn't right... The word about the rift between the Qixing and the Fatui should be out by now...

410010702.text: Have you ever stopped to consider that maybe this "secret intel" of yours is being "leaked" to you on purpose?

410010703.text: You mean, this is a ploy by the Qixing to control small and medium business owners?

410010704.text: Based on our interactions with others, it seems like you're the only one getting duped.

410010705.text: I... I've been scammed... by Ningguang...

410010706.text: You're not going to ask me to return my stuff now, are you?

410010707.text: Integrity is the cornerstone of being a merchant, so I won't go back on my word but... But... this is terrible...

410010708.text: Well, don't give up! You've still got a long life to lead!

410010709.text: You're right. My heart wasn't in the right place. How could the Qixing ever turn their backs on the people of Liyue in order to make a profit? Those everyday items are a necessity for the people to just get by. No one should attempt to corner the market like that, and I shouldn't have allowed myself to go along with it.

410010710.text: Friend, you have seen with your own eyes my very rise and fall. Let my mistakes be a lesson for you.

410010711.text: That lesson being... to not become a merchant?

410010712.text: *sigh* I'm going to need some time to myself to think about what's happened. Business will at least continue to go on, but in the immediate sense that doesn't help me a whole lot...

410010801.text: Ah, hello. Do you need something?

410010901.text: I'm here to do some business.

410010902.text: The items needed today are as such.

410011001.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'm here for my Box o' Marvels...</color>

410011002.text: Here you are: genuine goods at a pleasing price. Worst-case scenario, it'll top up your coin pouch.

410011101.text: I'm here to do some business.

410011102.text: I thought you'd already taken a Box o' Marvels for today? That said, feel free to inspect the others. You'll see I don't cheat any of my customers.

410011201.text: Can you run me through your background again?

410011202.text: I'm Liben, and once upon a time I sold curios.

410011203.text: But I've finally said goodbye to that now that I've made it enough to rub shoulders with the Qixing. No more Mr. Small-Time Merchant for me!

410011204.text: And that's why you and I are about to start doing business together, and both of us are going to make a handsome sum!

410011206.text: Simple. You find me a few basic every items, cooking ingredients and the like, and then you trade them with me for a Box o' Marvels, full of all kinds of nice little treasures.

410011207.text: Keep in mind that I've filled these Boxes o' Marvels with the fortune I made in my time as a seller of curios. There's no booby prizes to be found here, and I treat all my customers the same.

410011208.text: Why box them up and turn it into a lucky draw, you say?

410011209.text: What can I say, people like a gift box. It just makes everyone a little more inclined to get involved.

410011210.text: How do you earn any money like this?

410011211.text: See, this is where the clever bit comes in.

410011212.text: I have recently become privy to some highly confidential intel from the Qixing. It's tough times ahead for the whole of Teyvat, apparently.

410011213.text: If I start stockpiling everyday essentials now, before long I'll be able to sell them off at much higher prices and make a huge profit.

410011401.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels...

410011402.text: Here you are: genuine goods at a pleasing price. Worst-case scenario, it'll top up your coin pouch.

50039803.text: Courage ignites the sky and earth

50039804.text: Once more, victory heralds Natlan's path

50039805.text: We'll wait for you, we'll sing for you

50039806.text: Come back, brothers, come back, heroes

50039807.text: Once again, once again, burn bright!
